'''Reaper's World''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]]. It was the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] capital, colonized c. [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]; at the time it was idyllic, with green [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and blue mountains. [[Nilgaard Bioprocessing]] used up the planet's natural resources, leaving it in an ice age of glaciers. The planet had urban cityplexes.
